name: local-notebook-ai
description: Local Notebook AI - self-hosted, multi-user, NotebookLM-style RAG web application backed by Ollama.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api start:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "pnpm --filter api start:prod" "pnpm --filter web start"
